name: Post-Matric Scholarship BC EBC
provider: Backward Classes & EBC Welfare Department, Govt. of Bihar
eligibility: Students from Backward Class (BC) or Extremely Backward Class (EBC) categories, domiciled in Bihar, studying in Class 11-12 at a recognised institution. Family income must be within the limit set by the state.
benefit: Reimbursement of tuition and admission fees plus an annual maintenance allowance, as per state norms.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship SC ST
provider: SC & ST Welfare Department, Govt. of Bihar
eligibility: Students from Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories, domiciled in Bihar, studying in Class 11-12 at a recognised institution. Family income must be within the limit set by the state.
benefit: Full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees and a monthly maintenance allowance, as per state norms.

name: Mukhyamantri Balak Balika Protsahan Yojana
eligibility: Students of Bihar government schools who pass the Class 10 board examination with the division required by the scheme.
benefit: One-time incentive amount paid directly to the student's bank account.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Department of Welfare of SC & BC, Govt. of Haryana
eligibility: Scheduled Caste (SC) students, domiciled in Haryana, studying in Class 9-10 in a government or recognised school. Parental income must be within the scheme limit.
benefit: Annual scholarship and books/ad-hoc grant, as per scheme guidelines.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for BC Students
provider: Department of Welfare of SC & BC, Govt. of Haryana
eligibility: Backward Class (BC) students, domiciled in Haryana, studying in Class 9-10 in a government or recognised school. Parental income must be within the scheme limit.
benefit: Annual scholarship amount, as per scheme guidelines.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Department of Welfare of SC & BC, Govt. of Haryana
eligibility: Scheduled Caste (SC) students, domiciled in Haryana, studying in Class 11-12 at a recognised institution. Parental income must be within the scheme limit.
benefit: Reimbursement of compulsory fees and a maintenance allowance, as per scheme guidelines.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: ST, SC, Minority & Backward Class Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand
eligibility: Scheduled Caste (SC) students, domiciled in Jharkhand, studying in Class 1-10 in a government or recognised school. Family income must be within the scheme limit.
benefit: Annual scholarship amount based on class, as per scheme guidelines.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
provider: ST, SC, Minority & Backward Class Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand
eligibility: Scheduled Tribe (ST) students, domiciled in Jharkhand, studying in Class 1-10 in a government or recognised school. Family income must be within the scheme limit.
benefit: Annual scholarship amount based on class, as per scheme guidelines.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for BC OBC Students
provider: ST, SC, Minority & Backward Class Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand
eligibility: Backward Class (BC) and Other Backward Class (OBC) students, domiciled in Jharkhand, studying in Class 1-10 in a government or recognised school. Family income must be within the scheme limit.
benefit: Annual scholarship amount based on class, as per scheme guidelines.
